decision: D9 (2026-11-18): public listings on everywhere, in every town that has them. Local stack only; production is a separate gate.

whatPublicationGates.finding: Publication is not a runtime switch. Every public surface serves while an active private source policy exists and a town has a live, completed, unrevoked, unretired scan under it. ops-metrics `publicationPaused` means 'no active policy', and the docs' 'publication paused' was a statement of release status.

operatingControls.state: none paused (provider_acquisition v4, export_worker v6); none gates publication, so none was changed

whatPublicationGates.noEnvFlag: no environment flag or approval table gates publication (searched src, compose and schema)
whatPublicationGates.approvalMechanism: None exists for S4a.3 cohorts, fields, notices, geography or ceiling. D9 is recorded in DECISIONS-2026-11-18-S10, the S10 scorecard, the S9 runbook and the S5 public contract.

surfacesConfirmedLive.localEvaluationListings: 261 of 261 eligible towns answer 200, no errors (5 big towns returned 503 at 2 s before the refresh-swap shrank their row sets; all answer now). 171 towns serve listings, 1 partial, 85 unknown (no scan yet), 3 acquiring, 1 empty.
surfacesConfirmedLive.publicExport: 141 towns 200; 120 towns 404 no_public_export = 85 with no scan yet, 4 scans with no rows, 31 still holding sourceless scans (refresh in progress).
surfacesConfirmedLive.boundsAndDetail: served by the same live joins as the listings route
surfacesConfirmedLive.addressReviewPublisher: unchanged and not part of D9: all 48 reviewed bindings are suspended, and address auto-approval is a separate owner decision

e2e.s6Evidence: 21 passed (the 'never scanned' spec now stubs the coverage fact, because every live town has been scanned)

sourcelessScanRefresh.policy: Refresh first, swap after. A town holding only sourceless scans is due; its old scans keep serving until a fresh sourced scan from a succeeded run of the same provider exists, then they are retired and audited (actor system:refresh-swap).
sourcelessScanRefresh.tests: town-retirement.postgres.test.js (5 pass), overture-auto-acquisition.postgres 7 pass, alltheplaces-geoapify.postgres 9 pass

remaining.bottleneck: Overture runs, one town at a time (average 292 s a run, about 6.5 min between towns, about 9 towns an hour). AllThePlaces towns convert in about a minute each but only after Overture has refreshed the town.
